title: Oxygen family: oxides, hydrides and peroxides
basic_overview: Oxygen is anomalous; peroxide and superoxide units require explicit electron/oxidation-state counting.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Identify O–O unit. 2. Assign oxidation state. 3. Count electrons. 4. Compare bond order/magnetism.
extra_info_content.factors: Compact 2p orbitals and O–O repulsion explain several anomalies.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
